servicesSummary: Campaign for Freedom Ltd. Registrant campaigned for ongoing U.S. aid to Ukraine through direct outreach and grassroots engagement with the U.S. public. Direct outreach included advertising, holding public events, and public displays. Grassroots engagement largely focused on social media (both paid and organic social media) and included earned media appearances.
moneyExplanation: The supplemental statement reports $814,669.92 in total disbursements for this registrant during the filing period. These are registrant-level filing totals and are not automatically attributable to any one foreign principal.
extractionMethod: Text of the original DOJ FARA supplemental filing; source-verified structured extraction
coverage: Registrant-level filing totals are reported only when the form provides an explicit total. Itemized financial rows require an exact known principal, real date, counterparty, purpose and amount. U.S. political contacts require an itemized principal/date/contact/method/purpose row. No payment to a politician or principal-specific share is inferred.
